fields.default: Four habits our research team keeps on every project, whether it is a week of churn calls or a year-long study.

fields.name: body
fields.label: Text
fields.default:
Start with a decision

Every study begins with the decision it should inform and the date that decision gets made. If nobody is waiting on the answer, we do not run the study. It keeps research small, focused and on time.

Talk to the right people

Five well-chosen customers teach us more than twenty who happened to be free. We recruit for recent behavior, include people who struggled as well as people who thrived, and always pay for their time.

Record everything, share the moments

Every call is recorded and transcribed, but nobody is asked to watch an hour of video. We pull two-minute highlights and put them where the team already works: the roadmap doc, the sprint review, the all-hands.

Close the loop

When a study changes what we build, we tell the customers who took part. It is the single best reason people say yes the next time we ask.

  • A thank-you email within a day
  • A short note when the change ships
